title: Parallax CAD
summary: Browser-first parametric mechanical modeler with exact B-rep operations, constrained sketches, drawings, and local project persistence.
description: An early pre-alpha CAD environment focused on a precise sketch-to-solid workflow in the browser.
highlights: Builds exact extrusion and revolve geometry in a Web Worker.
Includes constraint-driven sketches, measurements, drawings, and STEP/STL export.
Keeps projects local with versioned IndexedDB autosave and recovery snapshots.
notes: Static production output is embedded by the portfolio; the Vite service is available for live development.

services.label: Parallax Vite app
services.description: Runs the live browser CAD environment locally.
